name: Streaming Quantitative Cooperation Analysis Among Cross Chain Smart Contracts Bdc65A0813
text: Quantitative Cooperation Analysis among Cross-chain Smart Contracts reports that numerous cooperating smart contracts form a complex interaction network that is difficult to evaluate. This independently corresponds to Kaal's premise that multi-party smart-contract arrangements create distinctive complexity, while qualifying the suggestion that blockchain infrastructure alone makes the arrangement sufficiently verifiable. The abstract does not establish whether the proposed evaluation method is unhackable.
